name: Canister Vacuum Cleaner
definition: A mains-powered household dry vacuum with the motor, filtration and collection system in a separate body connected to the cleaning head through a flexible hose and wand.
includedScope: Bagged and bagless household canister or cylinder dry vacuums
Models supplied with flexible hoses, wands and floor nozzles
excludedScope: Central vacuum systems, wet/dry tub vacuums and industrial dust extractors
Upright, cordless stick and handheld-only vacuums
Unverified bags, filters, hoses, nozzles or electrical variants
primaryApplications: Households prioritizing reach, collection capacity or exhaust filtration
headline: Canister vacuum airflow, bags, filtration, reach and buyer checks
description: This profile explains the separate-body architecture, bagged and bagless collection, hose and nozzle path, sound and pickup methods, and the exact consumable checks needed before comparing household canister vacuums.
metaDescription: Canister vacuum cleaner guide covering bagged and bagless systems, airflow, filtration, reach, sound, models and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, allergy, surface-care or operating advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, voltage, bag or bin, filters, hose, wand, nozzles and approved surfaces before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Separate motor-and-collection body connected through a flexible hose
keyFacts.evidence: Reviewed official products use the canister or cylinder architecture.
keyFacts.scope: Household dry vacuums; central and commercial tub machines are excluded.

keyFacts.label: Collection choice
keyFacts.value: Bagged and bagless formats require different maintenance and consumables
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages document bagged products and a bagless cyclone product.
keyFacts.scope: Named products; no universal hygiene ranking.

keyFacts.label: Performance method
keyFacts.value: IEC 62885-2:2026 covers household dry-vacuum performance measurement
keyFacts.evidence: IEC describes pickup, air-data and other user-relevant measurement methods for covered products.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match body, hose, wand, nozzle, bag or bin, filters and regional circuit
keyFacts.evidence: Official products publish different delivered tool, consumable and electrical configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Exact product number and sales market.

systemFlow.name: Surface interface
systemFlow.role: Presents suction and optional agitation to the approved surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Official kits list model-specific nozzles and tools.

systemFlow.name: Air transfer
systemFlow.componentFamily: Wand, flexible hose, couplings and seals
systemFlow.role: Carries debris-laden air to the separate body while providing reach.
systemFlow.evidence: Reviewed products document hoses, wands or operating radius.
systemFlow.scope: Exact assembly; leaks and blockage change results.

systemFlow.name: Collection
systemFlow.componentFamily: Disposable bag or reusable bin and separator
systemFlow.role: Captures bulk debris and defines emptying work.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources distinguish bagged and bagless systems.
systemFlow.scope: Usable capacity and consumables are model-specific.

systemFlow.name: Air movement
systemFlow.componentFamily: Mains motor, fan and power controls
systemFlow.role: Generates airflow through the connected path.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer pages publish model-specific input or air-data values.
systemFlow.scope: Motor input is not cleaning performance.

systemFlow.name: Exhaust filtration
systemFlow.componentFamily: Pre-motor and final filters, seals and exhaust path
systemFlow.role: Protects the motor and controls emitted dust under maintained conditions.
systemFlow.evidence: Reviewed products identify product-specific filters or retention systems.
systemFlow.scope: No medical outcome; whole-machine sealing matters.

variants.name: Bagged canister
variants.taskScale: Whole-home cleaning with sealed disposable collection
variants.operatorRelationship: User replaces a specified bag and services filters
variants.spaceConstraints: Bag storage, body parking and operating radius
variants.limitations: Bag labels and collars are not universally interchangeable.
variants.evidence: Philips, Miele, Nilfisk and Numatic publish bagged formats.

variants.name: Bagless canister
variants.taskScale: Household cleaning without disposable dust bags
variants.operatorRelationship: User empties the bin and cleans separator and filters
variants.limitations: No-bag operation does not mean no consumables or no dust exposure.
variants.evidence: Kärcher publishes the VC 3 bagless cyclone architecture.

variants.name: Long-reach cylinder
variants.taskScale: Larger routes, stairs and above-floor cleaning
variants.operatorRelationship: User pulls or carries the body while managing hose and cord
variants.spaceConstraints: Cable routing, turning clearance and storage
variants.limitations: Maximum radius does not prove effortless handling.
variants.evidence: Philips, Bosch and Numatic publish cord or cleaning-range data.

performanceMetrics.name: Dust pickup
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Removal of standardized dust or debris from a stated surface
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Nozzle, surface, test material, strokes and laboratory conditions matter
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not infer pickup from motor watts.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC defines household dry-vacuum performance methods.

performanceMetrics.name: Air data
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Airflow, vacuum or related motor-air-path performance
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Measurement position, hose and nozzle configuration change the value
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Source-specific air data are not automatically comparable.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC identifies air-data methods; Numatic publishes airflow and suction with its own definitions.

performanceMetrics.name: Operating radius
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Reach from outlet to cleaning point
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Cord, hose and wand definitions differ by manufacturer
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Confirm cable management and real room geometry.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Philips, Bosch, Numatic and Kärcher publish reach-related values.

performanceMetrics.name: Collection capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: How much material the specified bag or bin is designed to hold
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Nominal, gross and usable volume may differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Capacity alone does not establish airflow retention or emptying cleanliness.

performanceMetrics.name: Sound
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Declared airborne noise under a stated method
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Sound power and sound pressure are different quantities
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Compare only the same quantity, method and operating setup.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC publishes a household vacuum noise method; Philips states a product sound value.

applicationFit.assessment: Use the delivered multi-surface nozzle in a matched pickup and push-pull trial.

applicationFit.limitations: No universal nozzle ranking is supplied.

applicationFit.assessment: Review whole-machine emissions evidence, seals, bag changes and filter maintenance—not filter grade alone.

applicationFit.limitations: No health outcome or medical suitability is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Request test method, particle boundary, filter code and replacement procedure.
applicationFit.evidence: Official sources describe product-specific filtration systems.

applicationFit.assessment: Map outlet locations, thresholds, stairs, storage and cord handling before using a radius claim.
applicationFit.basis: Reach and body mobility are system and layout dependent.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Walk the intended route with the complete machine and tools.
applicationFit.evidence: Official products publish different cleaning ranges and dimensions.

componentStack.name: Nozzle and task tools
componentStack.role: Couples the air path to floors, upholstery and crevices.
componentStack.evidence: Official kits list different nozzles and attachments.
componentStack.scope: Family labels do not establish cross-model compatibility.

componentStack.name: Hose, wand and couplings
componentStack.role: Provides reach while maintaining a sealed airflow path.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturer kits identify model-specific connection systems.

componentStack.name: Bag or bin
componentStack.role: Stores collected material and defines the emptying interface.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages distinguish bag and bin formats.

componentStack.name: Motor and controls
componentStack.role: Generates airflow and provides power adjustment or start-stop control.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages publish product-specific electrical and control data.

componentStack.name: Filters and exhaust seals
componentStack.role: Protects the motor and controls re-emission.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources publish distinct filter arrangements.
componentStack.scope: No equivalence inferred from filter label alone.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Pickup, nozzle motion and edge performance
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Using motor input as cleaning output
procurementDecisions.assessment: Conduct a matched debris-and-surface trial with the delivered nozzle.
procurementDecisions.basis: Pickup depends on the complete air path and surface interface.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No normalized cross-brand result is supplied.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record debris, passes, pickup, push-pull force and tool changes.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm nozzle approval for delicate floors and rugs.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC separates measured performance from motor input; official kits vary.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Dust exposure, consumable cost and maintenance time
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming bagless means maintenance-free or bagged means sealed
procurementDecisions.assessment: Observe a full emptying or bag-change cycle and inspect seals.
procurementDecisions.basis: Collection architecture changes user contact and ongoing parts.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No medical or hygiene outcome is guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Price five years of bags and filters and document cleaning steps.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Match bag, filter and seal part numbers.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official products document different collection systems.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Operating radius, body mobility, cable and storage
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating the largest radius as productivity
procurementDecisions.assessment: Walk the complete route with outlets, thresholds and stairs mapped.
procurementDecisions.basis: Reach is only one part of handling.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No common productivity test is cited.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Measure plug changes, body snags, carrying and parking time.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Check cord rewind, hose bend radius and body stability.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish different reach and dimensional data.

engineeringChecks.reason: Voltage, frequency, plug and motor configuration are market-specific.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match the nameplate and product code to the installation market.

engineeringChecks.reason: Damage or incompatible connectors affect airflow and may create electrical risk on powered systems.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect hose, latch, contacts and replacement part numbers.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC includes associated current-carrying hoses and motorized heads in scope.

engineeringChecks.reason: Air bypass or incorrect consumables can change containment and performance.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify codes, closure, seals, cleaning and full drying instructions.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official models specify distinct collection and filtration systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Sound power and sound pressure are not interchangeable.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Request the declared quantity, standard, mode and setup.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC 60704-2-1:2026 defines particular noise methods for household dry vacuums.

standards.name: IEC 62885-2:2026
standards.applicability: Performance methods for covered household mains and cordless dry vacuums.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the edition scope and user-relevant measurement purpose.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-2:2026
standards.applicability: Safety requirements for covered household vacuum cleaners and associated motorized heads or current-carrying hoses.

standards.name: IEC 60704-2-1:2026
standards.applicability: Particular noise measurement methods for covered household dry vacuum cleaners.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the acoustic method scope.
standards.scope: Compare the same acoustic quantity and setup.
